# CLAUDE.md

Homebrew tap for [unsent](https://github.com/GeiserX/unsent). One formula, `Formula/unsent.rb`, installing the prebuilt release binaries.

- The formula is regenerated by unsent's release workflow (goreleaser `brews`) on every tag; hand edits here are overwritten by the next release.
- Check changes with `brew style Formula/unsent.rb` and a real `brew install` from the tap.
- The repo is public: no private paths, account names or first names anywhere.
